thread:
ravi: Quick check 51 5 layout proposal: introduce a compact chart mode (sparkline baseline) with a hover/focus breakdown showing token-type stacked bars. Keeps default dense charts smaller on dashboards. Thoughts?

emma: Love compact mode. small UX ask: the token vs $ toggle keeps getting hidden in chart headers. can we promote it to a persistent toolbar so it's consistent across org/project pages?

carol: If it's persistent, show the scope next to it e.g. "Scope: Org (ACME)" so users know whether they're viewing org or project billing. otherwise people get confused.

mike: Concern: mobile and narrow widths. if we put toolbar at top-right, make an icon-only collapse breakpoint (< 880px) with an accessible tooltip. aria should be explicit: `aria-label="Switch display: tokens or dollars. Scope: org/project"`.

ravi: For compact mode interaction: default sparkline, hover or keyboard focus expands to stacked breakdown. also allow a small persistent chevron to pin expanded state. keyboard focus must open the overlay.

billing-bot: Attached: invoice-2026-03-01-ACME.pdf and lineitems-2026-03-01.csv for layout reference.

emma: Copy nit: change CTA text to avoid ambiguity. use separate CTAs: `Download PDF` and `Export CSV (line items)`. users keep thinking CSV is a printable invoice.

carol: Also move "Export chargeback CSV" into a secondary menu (kebab) to prevent accidental exports. plus add a short confirmation toast.

mike: Accessibility: token color palette needs alternatives for colorblind printing. suggest patterned fills + >=4.5 contrast. also avoid red/green pairings for token-type colors.

ravi: Dev question: can we get CSS tokens for compact/full card widths and the icon-only toolbar state? I'll prototype the responsive behavior if design provides tokens.

emma: Analytics note: >65% of admins prefer org-level default for billing view. proposal: default to org for org-admins, otherwise remember last per-user preference. surface a tiny "revert to org" link when in project scope if user is admin.

carol: Implementation detail: persist user preference in settings and local fallback in localStorage for quick toggles. add a tooltip on first use: "You can pin your preferred billing scope in Settings."

mike: Minor: summary card should have two variants: full-width with detailed sparkline + metrics, and compact 60% width with metric badges stacked. provide spacing tokens for both.

ravi: I'll make two mocks (full + compact) and include hover/focus states, toolbar placement, and aria copy. will drop in #design in ~45m and tag you all.

billing-bot: Note: export spec updated: /internal/billing/exports-v3.md

emma: Thanks. tagging @design-ops for contrast cert. we'll review after mocks. :raised_hands:
